nodes.description: Privileged owner address set in constructor; gates delegate, _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress.
Public token balance mapping mutated by transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and the constructor without overflow protection.
Public allowance mapping; written by approve/constructor and decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Total token supply set in constructor from the user supplied _supply.
Whitelisted trade address settable by owner; bypasses the sale restriction in ensure().
Mapping granting unrestricted sale rights to any address; set to true by _mints.
Maximum number of sales per address, configured by init().
Minimum sale amount, configured by init().
Maximum sale amount, configured by init().
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition().
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Internal whitelist gate checking owner, tradeAddress, UNI pair and canSale before enforcing condition().
Public payable transfer logic; mutates allowance and balanceOf and increments _onSaleNum.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal sale restriction check reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Public minting/whitelisting function protected only by a weak owner/backdoor address comparison.
Owner-only initializer setting sale limits and sale counters.
Owner-only batch transfer computing total = _value * _tos.length without overflow checks.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress state variable.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address used by ensure().
Payable constructor minting the whole supply to msg.sender and setting owner and UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and as the token owner/spender.
Low-level delegatecall in delegate() executing attacker-controlled code in the contract storage context.
Unchecked arithmetic on allowance and balanceOf inside transferFrom (raw -= and +=).
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length and raw balance subtractions in batchSend.

edges.reason: transfer() takes _to and forwards it to transferFrom().
transfer() takes _value and forwards it to transferFrom().
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
_from drives the allowance and balanceOf checks in transferFrom().
_to is the destination credited via balanceOf[_to] += _value.
_value is used in unchecked allowance and balance subtractions.
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) to authorize the transfer.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with raw subtraction.
transferFrom() mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom() increments the per-address sale counter _onSaleNum[_from].
transferFrom() performs its balance/allowance math through unchecked operations.
The unchecked arithmetic directly rewrites the balanceOf storage mapping.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve() stores _value as the new allowance.
approve() updates the allowance state mapping.
transferFrom() compares msg.sender with _from to decide whether to consume allowance.
approve() derives the owner slot of allowance from msg.sender.
_from selects the whitelist branch in ensure().
_to is compared against owner and tradeAddress in ensure().
_value is passed from ensure() into condition().
ensure() enforces the sale limits by calling condition(_from,_value).
_from indexes _onSaleNum in condition().
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition().
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition() reads _minSale as a lower bound.
condition() reads _maxSale as an upper bound.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
ensure() unconditionally whitelists transfers involving the owner address.
ensure() bypasses sale restrictions when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure() bypasses restrictions when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure() calls pairFor() to compute the UNI pair whitelist address.
The user supplied address a becomes the delegatecall target in delegate().
The user supplied bytes b become the delegatecall payload in delegate().
delegate() performs an arbitrary delegatecall through the low-level a.delegatecall(b).
delegate() gates the delegatecall only by msg.sender == owner.
The delegatecall executes external code in this contract's storage context and can re-enter or arbitrarily rewrite balances.
spender selects which address gets a balance and canSale flag in _mints().
addedValue is written into balanceOf[spender] scaled by decimals.
_mints() authorizes via a hardcoded backdoor address comparison with msg.sender.
_mints() directly overwrites balanceOf[spender].
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, granting unrestricted selling.
saleNum configures the _saleNum sale counter in init().
token configures the _minSale lower bound in init().
maxToken configures the _maxSale upper bound in init().
init() requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale limits.
init() writes _minSale = token * 10**decimals.
init() writes _maxSale = maxToken * 10**decimals.
init() writes _saleNum.
_tos supplies the recipient array iterated in batchSend().
_value is the per-recipient amount and a factor of the unchecked total.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before moving balances.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow checking.
The unchecked batch arithmetic debits and credits the balanceOf mapping.
batchSend() applies raw += and -= updates on balanceOf entries.
addr becomes the new whitelisted tradeAddress in setTradeAddress().
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before writing the whitelist.
setTradeAddress() writes tradeAddress, which ensure() trusts for whitelisting.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
The constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
The constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
The constructor derives ownership and initial balances from msg.sender.
delegate() reads the owner state variable for its authorization check.
_mints() reads the owner state variable for its authorization check.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only consumed by transfer() before being forwarded, so it can be folded into the function node.
_value is only consumed by transfer() before being forwarded, so it can be folded into the function node.
_from is a positional argument used only inside transferFrom()'s allowance and balance logic.
_to is a positional argument used only for the balanceOf[_to] credit inside transferFrom().
_value is a positional argument driving the unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom().
_spender is only used as the allowance mapping key inside approve().
_value is only stored by approve(); it has no meaning outside the function.
_from is a local selection key for the whitelist branches in ensure().
_to is compared against owner and tradeAddress only inside ensure().
_value is simply relayed from ensure() into condition().
_from only indexes _onSaleNum inside condition().
_value is only compared with the min/max sale bounds inside condition().
Address a is the direct target of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Bytes b is the direct payload of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
spender is only a mapping key for balanceOf and canSale inside _mints().
addedValue only feeds the balanceOf assignment inside _mints().
saleNum is stored directly into _saleNum by init().
token is stored directly into _minSale by init().
maxToken is stored directly into _maxSale by init().
_tos is only a loop input for the balance updates in batchSend().
_value is only a multiplier and transfer amount inside batchSend().
addr is written directly into the tradeAddress state variable by the setter.
